name: elftia-plugin-pet-2d
description: 2D desktop pet plugin for Elftia — facts->state grammar, sprite player, character-pack contract, whale-girl-format compatibility.

scripts.build: tsx scripts/build-packs.ts && vite build --config vite.plugin.config.ts && vite build --config vite.plugin.manager.config.ts && vite build --config vite.plugin.main.config.ts && node scripts/stamp-manifest.mjs && node scripts/verify-dist.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run verify:packs && npm run build && npm run verify:trim
